The paper studies thermal freeze-in plus nonthermal production from _D decay.

unresolved_items: The extracted text omits the symbol/name of the fermion DM state and drops some exponent signs in coupling scans.

identity.name: Lepton-portal freeze-in scalar with hierarchical lepton couplings
identity.short_description: A keV-scale scalar dark matter candidate feebly coupled to Standard Model charged leptons, produced by freeze-in and capable of late radiative decay to photons.
identity.historical_origin_or_motivation: The paper proposes the charged-lepton portal as a concrete freeze-in realization of late-decaying dark matter for reducing the Hubble tension.

mediators: charged leptons in the effective portal
possible vector-like leptons in a UV realization
long_lived_particles: phi dark matter with lifetime longer than the age of the Universe

dark_sector_couplings: lambda_e << lambda_mu << lambda_tau = lambda, with production dominated by heavier-lepton couplings
decay_channels: phi -> gamma gamma for m_phi below charged-lepton thresholds
phi -> charged lepton pair when kinematically allowed

theory.notes: The text gives an effective scalar coupling to charged leptons and notes possible realization through vector-like fermions mixed with SM leptons.

symmetries.stabilizing_mechanism: No exact stabilizing symmetry is specified; the feeble portal makes phi cosmologically long-lived while allowing late decay.

mechanisms: freeze-in from Standard Model thermal bath
inverse decay of charged leptons or photons
production.notes: The paper focuses its late-decay cosmology analysis on the hierarchical coupling case.

nonstandard_features: out-of-equilibrium freeze-in
late decay to photons after freeze-in
possible subcomponent dark matter fraction

phase_space_bounds: The paper notes Lyman-alpha relevance for subdominant keV dark matter.
phase_space.notes: Freeze-in production gives an out-of-equilibrium scalar population.

linear.impact_on_sigma8_s8: The paper reports a lower best-fit sigma_8 in the late-decay scenario.

validity_domain.condition: Portal couplings are small enough that phi never thermalizes with the SM bath.

global.description: The relic calculation assumes CP conservation so inverse decay and decay amplitudes are related.
The charged-lepton portal is treated as an effective interaction; explicit UV realizations are outside the paper scope.

dominant_uncertainties: The UV completion is sketched but not built in detail.
The keV-scale phase-space and late-decay implications require care outside the extracted model-only fields.
